allowed_input_signals.safe_use: Select score band language only after Phase 10 calibration; before calibration use as draft evidence with confidence note.
Mention observed strengths such as role match, strong skill overlap, experience match, or requirement coverage.
Mention observed gaps such as missing required skill, experience gap, low requirement coverage, or unknown language.
Name matched skills only when the normalized candidate skill and job skill intersection exists.
Name missing required job skills only when they appear in job requirements and are absent from normalized candidate evidence.
Mention CV/ATS quality band only after Phase 10 calibration; before calibration use as draft evidence with caveat.
Mention ATS risks only from stable issue keys and severity.
Mention target role or requirement only when present in the request/job record.
allowed_input_signals.source_contract: job title, role family, required skills, requirements, and description text available to model core

allowed_input_signals.safe_use: Choose or flag localization mode; UNKNOWN must trigger fallback or wrapper locale decision.

blocked_until_later_phases: Production score-band wording requires Phase 10 calibration evidence.
API wrapper implementation must enforce evidence ledger, fallback, and quality checks before release.
Manual review is required for PII, unsupported skill, unsupported seniority, or language mismatch failures.

model_owned_fields.grounding_rule: Chosen deterministically from allowed signals, fallback triggers, and quality checks.
Each item must map to summarySignals or matchedSkills with sourceEvidenceKeys.
Each item must map to missingSignals or missingSkills with sourceEvidenceKeys.
Each item must map to Phase 7 detectedIssues and must not expose raw PII.
Set when fallback trigger fires; wrapper must render uncertainty instead of normal template.
Derived from Phase 3 language normalization; UNKNOWN delegates locale choice to wrapper with caveat.
Only data quality, parser, calibration, language, or out-of-distribution notes.
Every rendered slot must identify source path and sourceEvidenceKeys.

public_api_mapping.analysisResult.atsFriendliness.summary: Rendered separately by wrapper from ATS signals; not an input to overall impression core.
public_api_mapping.analysisResult.jobFitAlignment.summary: Rendered separately by wrapper from job-fit signals; not an input to overall impression core.
public_api_mapping.analysisResult.overallImpression: API wrapper renders one concise string from templateId, evidence-backed slots, fallbackReason, languageMode, and confidenceNotes.

wrapper_requirements: Render only slots with evidenceLedger entries.
Drop optional clauses whose evidence is missing.
Prefer fallback copy when fallbackReason is not null.
Keep the public value a string as required by OpenAPI.
Do not read generated jobFitAlignment.summary or atsFriendliness.summary as evidence.

fallback_policy.safe_summary_intent: Explain that the CV could not be read well enough for a reliable overall impression.
fallback_policy.trigger: empty_text issue, extracted_character_count below minimum, or parser_status indicates failed parse
fallback_policy.wrapper_guidance: Render a short parseability caveat and ask for a readable CV; do not summarize job fit.

fallback_policy.safe_summary_intent: Summarize only CV/ATS signals and state that job-specific fit cannot be assessed.
fallback_policy.trigger: no job title, role target, requirements, or candidate job context is supplied
fallback_policy.wrapper_guidance: Use generic 'target role' wording only when product UX requires a placeholder; otherwise state missing job target.

fallback_policy.safe_summary_intent: Keep wording language-neutral or use user/request locale while flagging language uncertainty.
fallback_policy.trigger: normalized language is UNKNOWN or language evidence conflicts across sources
fallback_policy.wrapper_guidance: Prefer configured UI locale; do not translate skill names unless alias table supports it.

fallback_policy.safe_summary_intent: Show limited impression and list only strongest observed evidence with caveat.
fallback_policy.trigger: confidenceNotes contain low_text_coverage, out_of_distribution_role, unknown_experience, unstable_score, or calibration_missing
fallback_policy.wrapper_guidance: Use confidence_limited_v1 template and avoid decisive language.

fallback_policy.safe_summary_intent: State that there is not enough explainable evidence to produce an impression.
fallback_policy.trigger: score exists but summarySignals, missingSignals, matchedSkills, missingSkills, and detectedIssues are empty
fallback_policy.wrapper_guidance: Render a minimal uncertainty message and log quality check failure for review.

forbidden_inferences.rule: Do not mention a skill unless it is in matchedSkills, missingSkills, or target job requirements with source evidence.
Do not claim junior, mid, senior, lead, or manager unless target role/seniority or normalized experience evidence explicitly supports it.
Do not infer tenure, employer quality, gaps, promotions, or verified work history from CV text unless explicit evidence exists.
Never infer age, gender, religion, ethnicity, marital status, health, disability, or nationality.
Never claim ATS pass/fail, interview chance, hiring probability, or recruiter preference.
Do not use topActionables, sectionReviews, hydrated job details, auth, persistence, or wrapper summaries as model evidence.
Do not render raw email, phone, URL, address, or other PII in impression text.

promotion_gate.current_decision: GO for grounded signal and wrapper design; NO-GO for production copy claims until Phase 10 calibration and wrapper implementation checks exist.
manual_review_required_for: unknown language or low text coverage clusters
any unsupported seniority or skill claim
promotion_gate.phase10_dependency: Score-band wording and confidence semantics must be calibrated before release claims are finalized.

quality_checks.condition: Every rendered slot has an evidenceLedger entry with sourcePath and non-empty sourceEvidenceKeys.
quality_checks.fail_action: Drop the slot; if required slot missing, render fallback confidence_limited_v1.

quality_checks.condition: Every skill token in the rendered string appears in matchedSkills, missingSkills, target job required skills, or approved alias table.
quality_checks.fail_action: Remove skill mention and log evidence mismatch; block release if repeated.

quality_checks.condition: Any junior/mid/senior/lead/manager wording has explicit source evidence from target role, normalized experience, or job requirement.
Rendered locale matches languageMode or wrapper UI locale when languageMode is UNKNOWN; skill aliases are not translated without alias evidence.
quality_checks.fail_action: Use wrapper locale fallback and preserve original skill labels.

quality_checks.condition: If fallbackReason is set, only the matching fallback template may render.
quality_checks.fail_action: Replace normal template with fallback output.

quality_checks.condition: Rendered string contains no pass/fail, interview chance, recruiter preference, or hiring probability language.
quality_checks.fail_action: Reject rendered string and log prohibited phrase.

quality_checks.condition: Rendered string contains no raw email, phone, URL, address, or identifier values from CV/contact evidence.
quality_checks.fail_action: Remove PII-bearing phrase and force manual review.

quality_checks.condition: ATS evidence describes CV quality only; job-fit evidence describes alignment only.
Rendered impression stays concise and uses no more than one strength clause, one gap clause, and one risk/caveat clause.

inherited_blockers: Classifier training is blocked until benchmark labels exist with enough examples per issue family.
Complex JobFitAlignment training must wait for a materialized balanced pair dataset with high-fit validation/test coverage.
Production ATS score semantics require Phase 10 calibration evidence.
Production score semantics must wait for Phase 10 calibration.
Promotion must wait for human validation labels or equivalent trusted validation evidence.
Ranking-objective promotion must wait for backend-like candidate sets and relevance labels.
Release claims are blocked until empty-text and critical parse failures receive manual review.

slot_policy.ats_risk_evidence: One critical/high ATS issue or concise aggregate from detectedIssues; no raw PII.
slot_policy.available_strength_evidence: Optional observed strength; omit if none exists.
slot_policy.confidence_caveat: Data-quality or model-confidence note from confidenceNotes, parser status, unknown language, or missing job target.
slot_policy.strength_evidence: One or two items from summarySignals or matchedSkills with source evidence.
slot_policy.target_role_or_job_context: Use explicit target role, job title, or generic 'target role/job' fallback; never infer seniority from title text alone.
slot_policy.top_gap_evidence: One or two items from missingSignals or missingSkills with source evidence.

summary_templates.condition: jobfit_band in high_or_upper_medium and at least one matched_skill or strength signal exists
summary_templates.evidence_rule: strength_evidence must come from summarySignals or matchedSkills; gap/risk clauses omitted when evidence is absent.
summary_templates.template_en: Strong alignment for {target_role_or_job_context} based on {strength_evidence}; review {top_gap_evidence} and {ats_risk_evidence} before applying.
summary_templates.template_id_locale: Kesesuaian kuat untuk {target_role_or_job_context} berdasarkan {strength_evidence}; tinjau {top_gap_evidence} dan {ats_risk_evidence} sebelum melamar.

summary_templates.condition: jobfit_band in medium and at least one strength plus one gap exists
summary_templates.evidence_rule: Both strength and gap evidence must have distinct sourceEvidenceKeys.
summary_templates.template_en: Moderate alignment for {target_role_or_job_context}: {strength_evidence} is supported, while {top_gap_evidence} needs attention.
summary_templates.template_id_locale: Kesesuaian sedang untuk {target_role_or_job_context}: {strength_evidence} sudah terlihat, sementara {top_gap_evidence} perlu diperbaiki.

summary_templates.condition: jobfit_band in low or multiple required gaps are present
summary_templates.evidence_rule: Do not say the candidate is unqualified; describe only observed missing requirements or low coverage.
summary_templates.template_en: Current evidence shows limited alignment for {target_role_or_job_context}, mainly because {top_gap_evidence}.
summary_templates.template_id_locale: Bukti saat ini menunjukkan kesesuaian terbatas untuk {target_role_or_job_context}, terutama karena {top_gap_evidence}.

summary_templates.condition: critical or high ATS issue exists, regardless of job-fit score
summary_templates.evidence_rule: ATS risk evidence must come from detectedIssues with severity high or critical.
summary_templates.template_en: The main limitation is CV readability or structure: {ats_risk_evidence}. Use job-fit signals only after the CV can be parsed reliably.
summary_templates.template_id_locale: Batasan utama ada pada keterbacaan atau struktur CV: {ats_risk_evidence}. Gunakan sinyal job-fit setelah CV dapat diparse dengan andal.

summary_templates.condition: low confidence note, unknown language, missing job target, or incomplete parser evidence exists
summary_templates.evidence_rule: Fallback or caveat must be rendered when required role, language, parser, or confidence evidence is missing.
summary_templates.template_en: The impression is limited because {confidence_caveat}. Only the observed signals should be used for decisions.
summary_templates.template_id_locale: Impresi ini terbatas karena {confidence_caveat}. Gunakan hanya sinyal yang benar-benar teramati untuk keputusan.
